fundamentals.title: How the browser builds a page
fundamentals.outcome: Trace how source files become a rendered, interactive page and use browser tools to inspect it.

lessons.title: The web platform
lessons.focus: HTML describes structure, CSS presentation, JavaScript behavior, and the browser provides runtime services.

lessons.title: DOM, CSSOM, and rendering
lessons.focus: Relate source markup and styles to the document tree, style rules, layout, paint, and interaction.

lessons.title: Inspecting a running page
lessons.focus: Use the Elements, Styles, Console, and Network panels to form and test a debugging hypothesis.

battery.title: Trace a page load
battery.task: Given a starter project, identify the entry document and trace each linked stylesheet and script.

battery.title: Find the visual cause
battery.task: Inspect a page with a missing style and determine whether the cause is markup, selector matching, or loading.

battery.title: Explain a browser change
battery.task: Change one element and describe which part of the rendered page updates and why.

fundamentals.title: HTML structure and semantics
fundamentals.outcome: Write meaningful, well-formed documents with native semantics and useful page metadata.

lessons.title: Document skeleton and metadata
lessons.focus: Doctype, language, title, character encoding, viewport, and metadata that describes the document.

lessons.title: Text, links, images, lists, and tables
lessons.focus: Choose elements by meaning; write descriptive links and text alternatives; use tables for tabular data.

lessons.title: Landmarks and content structure
lessons.focus: Use main, header, nav, article, section, aside, and footer according to their semantics.

lessons.title: Attributes and element relationships
lessons.focus: Understand global attributes, IDs, classes, data attributes, and valid parent-child relationships.

battery.title: Repair a document outline
battery.task: Fix heading order, landmark placement, and invalid nesting in a starter article.

battery.title: Build an information page
battery.task: Create an article with a meaningful heading structure, navigation, links, and an informative image.

battery.title: Semantic choice check
battery.task: Choose native elements for navigation, emphasis, quotations, dates, and tabular data, then explain the choices.

fundamentals.title: Forms and browser-native behavior
fundamentals.outcome: Build forms that communicate purpose, use native validation, and work by keyboard.

lessons.title: Labels and control types
lessons.focus: Associate labels with controls and select input types that fit the data being collected.

lessons.title: Grouping and instructions
lessons.focus: Use fieldset, legend, help text, required state, and error messages that are programmatically related.

lessons.title: Constraints and submission
lessons.focus: Use built-in constraints, understand submit events, and provide clear invalid, pending, and success states.

lessons.title: Focus and keyboard behavior
lessons.focus: Keep a logical tab order, visible focus, and predictable submission behavior.

battery.title: Accessible profile form
battery.task: Build a labeled profile form with appropriate types, required fields, and native constraints.

battery.title: Fix an inaccessible form
battery.task: Repair missing labels, unclear errors, and keyboard traps in a supplied form.

battery.title: Validation cases
battery.task: Try empty, malformed, boundary, and valid input; record the browser behavior for each.

fundamentals.title: CSS foundations and visual rules
fundamentals.outcome: Predict how the cascade, values, and box model determine an element’s final appearance and size.

lessons.title: Rules, selectors, and matching
lessons.focus: Type, class, ID, attribute, pseudo-class, pseudo-element, combinator, and selector lists.

lessons.title: Cascade, specificity, and inheritance
lessons.focus: Resolve origin, importance, layers, specificity, source order, and inherited values.

lessons.title: Values, units, and custom properties
lessons.focus: Use lengths, percentages, viewport and font-relative units, functions, and design tokens.

lessons.title: Box model and sizing
lessons.focus: Reason about content, padding, border, margin, box-sizing, overflow, and intrinsic sizing.

lessons.title: Typography, color, backgrounds, and borders
lessons.focus: Set readable type, contrast, decoration, surfaces, and robust visual states.

battery.title: Cascade prediction set
battery.task: Predict the winning declaration for several selector and source-order combinations.

battery.title: Fix a clipped card
battery.task: Find and repair a box-sizing, width, and overflow combination that clips content.

battery.title: Style from constraints
battery.task: Create a readable content card using spacing, type, color, and focus-state requirements.

fundamentals.title: Layout and responsive design
fundamentals.outcome: Build resilient layouts that respond to content, viewport size, and user settings.

lessons.title: Normal flow and formatting contexts
lessons.focus: Understand block and inline flow, containing blocks, stacking, and positioning.

lessons.title: Flexbox
lessons.focus: Use axes, alignment, wrapping, flexible sizing, gaps, and ordering for one-dimensional layouts.

lessons.title: CSS Grid
lessons.focus: Define tracks, gaps, placement, repeat patterns, and responsive grids for two-dimensional layouts.

lessons.title: Responsive rules and queries
lessons.focus: Use content-driven breakpoints, media features, container queries, and reduced-motion preferences.

lessons.title: Images and intrinsic content
lessons.focus: Use responsive image sources, object fitting, and min/max sizing for long or variable content.

battery.title: Responsive navigation
battery.task: Make a navigation layout work for narrow screens, long labels, and keyboard focus.

battery.title: Grid under pressure
battery.task: Repair a card grid that overflows with narrow viewports and uneven card content.

battery.title: Viewport variation set
battery.task: Check a page at narrow, medium, and wide widths and justify each layout transition.

fundamentals.title: Reusable CSS and styling systems
fundamentals.outcome: Organize styles for reuse and compare native CSS with common styling tools.

lessons.title: Custom properties and design tokens
lessons.focus: Create scoped tokens, theme variants, and meaningful fallbacks.

lessons.title: Architecture and component styling
lessons.focus: Name classes, control scope, reduce accidental coupling, and organize responsive states.

lessons.title: Sass and SCSS
lessons.focus: Variables, nesting, mixins, functions, modules, loops, and the CSS they compile to.

lessons.title: Utility and component frameworks
lessons.focus: Compare Bootstrap, Bulma, and Tailwind patterns, configuration, and generated styles.

battery.title: Refactor repeated styles
battery.task: Extract repeated values and component rules into a maintainable set of tokens and classes.

battery.title: Compare styling approaches
battery.task: Implement one responsive component using plain CSS and one selected framework approach.

battery.title: Specificity cleanup
battery.task: Reduce an escalating selector override chain while preserving the required states.

fundamentals.title: JavaScript fundamentals for interfaces
fundamentals.outcome: Use JavaScript’s core language constructs to model data and express interface behavior.

lessons.title: Values, variables, and types
lessons.focus: Primitive values, objects, coercion, equality, declarations, and immutable bindings.

lessons.title: Conditions, loops, and iteration
lessons.focus: Choose clear branching and iteration strategies for UI data.

lessons.title: Functions
lessons.focus: Declarations and expressions, parameters, return values, scope, closures, callbacks, and recursion.

lessons.title: Arrays and objects
lessons.focus: Transform collections, access properties safely, and represent application state.

lessons.title: Errors and modules
lessons.focus: Throw and handle errors, separate responsibilities, and import/export reusable modules.

lessons.title: Language-specific behavior
lessons.focus: Understand this, prototypes, destructuring, optional chaining, and other JavaScript idioms.

battery.title: Function fluency set
battery.task: Implement small pure functions for validation, formatting, and deriving display data.

battery.title: Repair a state bug
battery.task: Trace mutation and stale-value bugs in a small interface data transformation.

battery.title: Explain the closure
battery.task: Predict callback output and explain which bindings remain available and why.

fundamentals.title: DOM, events, and interaction patterns
fundamentals.outcome: Build predictable interactions using DOM events and explicit interface state.

lessons.title: Selecting and updating elements
lessons.focus: Query the DOM, create nodes, update attributes, and distinguish text from HTML injection.

lessons.title: Events and propagation
lessons.focus: Understand event targets, bubbling, capture, default actions, and delegation.

lessons.title: State and rendering
lessons.focus: Keep application state clear and render lists and interface states consistently.

lessons.title: Native interaction patterns
lessons.focus: Build disclosure, tabs, menus, dialogs, and status feedback with semantics and focus management.

battery.title: Search and filter list
battery.task: Build a searchable list with empty, match, and no-result states.

battery.title: Event propagation lab
battery.task: Diagnose duplicate event handling and implement one delegated listener.

battery.title: Keyboard interaction check
battery.task: Verify a tabs or disclosure pattern using keyboard only and repair focus behavior.

fundamentals.title: Asynchronous JavaScript and browser APIs
fundamentals.outcome: Handle asynchronous work and browser capabilities with explicit loading and failure behavior.

lessons.title: Promises and async functions
lessons.focus: Chain, await, and handle asynchronous results and errors.

lessons.title: Fetching and cancellation
lessons.focus: Request data, interpret responses, handle errors, and avoid stale updates.

lessons.title: Storage, URL, and history
lessons.focus: Use browser persistence and navigation APIs with clear constraints.

lessons.title: Observers and platform APIs
lessons.focus: Choose APIs such as ResizeObserver and MutationObserver for the job rather than polling.

battery.title: Data loading states
battery.task: Build loading, success, empty, and error states using a provided local mock response.

battery.title: Race-condition repair
battery.task: Fix an interface that displays an older response after a newer search.

battery.title: API choice check
battery.task: Choose an observer or event API for several UI changes and explain the tradeoff.

fundamentals.title: Accessible and robust UI behavior
fundamentals.outcome: Make interface content and controls understandable and operable across input methods and assistive technology.

lessons.title: Semantic controls and accessible names
lessons.focus: Prefer native controls and ensure interactive elements have clear names and roles.

lessons.title: Keyboard and focus
lessons.focus: Support logical order, visible focus, managed focus, and no keyboard traps.

lessons.title: Contrast, motion, and content alternatives
lessons.focus: Respect text alternatives, contrast, reduced motion, zoom, and reflow.

lessons.title: ARIA and live updates
lessons.focus: Use ARIA only to fill semantic gaps and announce meaningful dynamic changes.

battery.title: Keyboard-only audit
battery.task: Complete a supplied workflow without a pointer and repair any inaccessible control.

battery.title: Accessible status messages
battery.task: Add clear success and error feedback to a dynamic form without stealing focus.

battery.title: Semantic repair lab
battery.task: Replace misleading clickable elements with controls that expose the right behavior.

fundamentals.title: Testing, debugging, and quality
fundamentals.outcome: Reproduce problems, gather evidence, and verify fixes with behavior-focused checks.

lessons.title: Reproduction and hypotheses
lessons.focus: Write reliable reproduction steps and isolate one likely cause at a time.

lessons.title: Console, network, and layout inspection
lessons.focus: Use developer tools to inspect errors, requests, DOM state, and computed layout.

lessons.title: Behavior checks
lessons.focus: Test expected interactions, edge cases, keyboard behavior, and responsive states.

lessons.title: Validation and regression prevention
lessons.focus: Confirm the fix against the original failure and nearby behavior.

battery.title: Seeded bug investigation
battery.task: Resolve a multi-symptom page defect and submit evidence for the root cause.

battery.title: Write a behavior checklist
battery.task: Create checks for a form or interaction covering normal and edge cases.

battery.title: Regression challenge
battery.task: Fix a reported issue while preserving existing interaction behavior.

fundamentals.title: Performance and production readiness
fundamentals.outcome: Measure user-visible performance and improve the page without breaking behavior.

lessons.title: Loading and rendering costs
lessons.focus: Understand resource loading, critical CSS, script timing, and expensive rendering work.

lessons.title: Responsive assets and efficient updates
lessons.focus: Use right-sized assets and avoid unnecessary layout, paint, and DOM work.

lessons.title: Measure before optimizing
lessons.focus: Use browser performance tools and distinguish observations from assumptions.

lessons.title: Progressive enhancement
lessons.focus: Keep core content useful when scripts, APIs, or network resources are unavailable.

battery.title: Performance investigation
battery.task: Inspect a deliberately inefficient page and identify the measured bottleneck.

battery.title: Resilient enhancement
battery.task: Keep a page usable when one optional browser capability is unavailable.

battery.title: Before-and-after review
battery.task: Record a performance symptom, make one change, and compare the result.

fundamentals.title: Web fundamentals capstone
fundamentals.outcome: Plan, build, and verify a complete small interface using the shared web platform skills.

lessons.title: Plan the interface
lessons.focus: Define users, content structure, interaction states, and acceptance criteria.

lessons.title: Build in layers
lessons.focus: Start with semantic HTML, add resilient CSS, then implement only needed behavior.

lessons.title: Verify and reflect
lessons.focus: Check functionality, accessibility, responsiveness, and performance; explain tradeoffs.

battery.title: Build a small multi-state interface
battery.task: Create a responsive, accessible interface with at least one form or dynamic interaction.

battery.title: Capstone review
battery.task: Use a provided rubric to test behavior, keyboard access, narrow layouts, and error states.
